decisive_items: KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R identified as the only somatic mutation
Discrete clusters of small-caliber vessels were observed, with superficial, small lobules of small-caliber vessels
response.rationale: The presence of a somatic KDR (VEGFR2) mutation and the histopathological findings of small-caliber vessel clusters support the diagnosis of a vascular lesion associated with the mutation.

rejected.why: Lack of genetic findings to support Cutaneous Angiokeratoma
Telangiectasia is a feature of the lesion, but not a specific diagnosis
No specific genetic or histopathological findings to support Cutaneous Collateral Vessel Formation
Cherry Angioma is a possible diagnosis, but the size and growth pattern of the lesion are atypical
